boundary_diagnosis.confirmed: The installed side panel turns a legitimate guest allowance refusal into a generic retryable chat failure at the client HTTP-error presentation boundary.
boundary_diagnosis.source_contract_gap: Frozen published 0.2.176 has no guest-allowance-specific HTTP classification: every HTTP 402 follows streamErrorMessage's generic default and the normal Retry interruption. The later pending 0.2.181/current-main source adds isGuestAllowanceUsed, but recognizes only status 403 with a top-level error field equal to guest_ai_allowance_used; the live refusal for the reproduced send was status 402.
boundary_diagnosis.qualification: The frozen 0.2.176 source was verified at its published SHA. The later 403-only classifier is a separate candidate gap, not code running in the installed 0.2.176. Exact live 402 response-body shape was not captured.
